summary: Iteration 6 — Validated RBAC (admin/collaborator/spectator), profit tracking, new templates (NAS Setup, Server Setup, General Network Setup, UniFi Setup, Laptop Repair, Laptop Cleaning, Console Cleaning) + legacy retention, Users CRUD with last-admin guard, profile username update, MoneyInput clear-to-0 behavior, Reports page, and nav gating. Backend: 20 new tests in test_rbac_iter6.py — all PASS. Regression on test_audit_new.py (6/6) + test_security_card.py (16/16) + backend_test.py (38/40) — 80 passed, 2 pre-existing failures unrelated to this iteration (admin email changed in DB from admin@houstonlab.local to JanPilat.bp@gmail.com; legacy test_login_with_email and hard-coded email assertion in test_login_with_username broke). Frontend: sidebar shows Finance/Audit/Users & Roles/Reports for admin; /users add dialog opens with user-username/user-email/user-name/user-password/user-role/user-active (singular prefix); /reports renders no 'internal_notes' text; JobDetail Finance tab shows Internal costs section + parts_cost/other_costs/Profit summary; MoneyInput commits empty value to '0' on blur. Report button on JobDetail present.

minor.issue: Admin email has been changed from admin@houstonlab.local to JanPilat.bp@gmail.com in the DB (likely via the new profile-username/email editing feature). backend_test.py::test_login_with_email and test_login_with_username's email assertion both fail because of hard-coded 'admin@houstonlab.local'. The legacy test should either be updated to read the admin email from /auth/me first, or the /app/memory/test_credentials.md should be refreshed to reflect the new email.

issues: Recharts warning in console: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — dashboard chart container renders with no dimensions on first paint. Cosmetic, not broken.

action_items: Minor doc fix: update /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin email is now JanPilat.bp@gmail.com (not admin@houstonlab.local). Alternatively revert the admin email via /auth/profile to keep legacy tests green.
Consider fixing backend_test.py::TestAuth::test_login_with_username/email to dynamically read the admin identity rather than hard-coding 'admin@houstonlab.local'.

Review request description references dialog testids as 'users-username/email/name/password/role/active' but the code uses singular 'user-username' etc. (only the Add button and table use plural 'users-*'). Either update the description or rename testids for consistency.
Optional: surface a small border/loading state on Recharts containers to silence the width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first paint.
Carry-over (not introduced this iter): CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True; deprecated @app.on_event; empty-catch swallowing /audit/summary errors in SecurityCard.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard_routes._strip_finance_for_role hard-codes currency='CZK' for the stripped profit key — this drops the configured settings.currency. Use settings.currency or mirror payload.revenue.currency consistently.

users_routes.update_user uses Pydantic .model_dump() to derive update fields — because UserUpdatePayload fields default to None, any None value is correctly skipped BUT a client passing 'role': null will silently no-op instead of 400. Acceptable, but worth documenting.

dashboard_routes._job_profit is defined but never used (only _job_internal_cost + inline paid-internal compute); either remove or use it in /dashboard/finance to avoid drift — currently /stats uses _job_profit and /finance inlines the formula, so they could diverge.

users_routes._public is equivalent to find_one's projection {'_id':0,'password_hash':0} — listing already projects; post-create and post-update use _public on the in-memory doc. OK but duplication can be removed.

Reports page sheet HTML still contains the string 'Secrets hidden in customer report.' as a user-facing notice — this is a correct, intentional label (not a leak). When asserting 'no secret leak' in automation, match on actual secret values/labels via job.secrets[] rather than the word 'secret'.
MoneyInput select-all-on-focus should only fire when value==0 per PRD — verified: a field with value=3500 appended '9' (no select-all) which is correct; empty + blur commits to '0' which is correct.

rca of the issue: backend_test.py auth failures RCA: admin user document in MongoDB has email='JanPilat.bp@gmail.com' instead of seed default 'admin@houstonlab.local'. Either the seed_admin path updates email on each run, or an admin changed it via the new /api/auth/profile email-update flow (this iteration also allows username updates — email was already editable in prior iters). Reproduction: GET /api/auth/me with admin token returns email='JanPilat.bp@gmail.com'. Mitigation: (a) revert via admin_client.post('/api/auth/profile', json={'email':'admin@houstonlab.local'}), OR (b) refactor legacy tests to `me = client.get('/auth/me').json(); assert me['username']=='admin'` (don't hardcode email), OR (c) update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to reflect the new email.
